query: NVIDIA Gaming segment revenue Q4 fiscal 2026 standalone GeForce

output.content: NVIDIA reported **Q4 fiscal 2026 Gaming and AI PC revenue of $3.727 billion** (typically rounded to **$3.7 billion**), for the quarter ended **January 25, 2026**; this was down **13% sequentially** and up **47% year over year**. NVIDIA does not report a separate standalone **GeForce** revenue line—GeForce is included within the reported Gaming and AI PC platform. [[1]] [[2]]
